caption: The drawing features a single, transparent wine glass centered on a plain, off-white background. The glass is depicted in a realistic style using shades of gray and black pencil, providing detail to the contours and reflective surfaces of the object. The bowl of the glass is rounded and smoothly transitions into a short stem, which is ornamented with a small ring midway. The stem extends downward to a broad, circular base. The rendering uses varying pressures and strokes to indicate highlights and shadows, suggesting the reflective and translucent properties of glass. There are no additional objects or elements in the composition, and the background is unadorned.
title: Glass
